headline: Low interaction risk overall; no shared execution or filesystem surfaces, but Airflow’s broad egress could still amplify downstream misuse if paired outputs are trusted.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Airflow has no browser or shared channel to LightZero by default, and LightZero has no MCP, filesystem, or network ingress surfaces that would ingest Airflow output. With no documented bridge between them, prompt-injection-style takeover is not plausible from the profiles alone.
conditions: IF an external orchestrator copies Airflow text into LightZero prompts or configs, injection becomes possible.
mitigations: Keep the agents isolated with no copy-paste bridge.
Do not feed Airflow logs directly into LightZero prompts.
requires-engineering: add provenance tags to any shared text channel.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Airflow lists no data classes touched and LightZero cannot read files or egress network, so there is no documented path for sensitive data to flow from one agent to the other. The pair lacks a shared workspace or authenticated shared principal in the profiles.
conditions: IF both agents are later granted access to the same sensitive workspace, leakage risk appears.
mitigations: Do not place secrets in any shared directory.
Review Airflow task logs for accidental secret material.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Airflow exposes broad network egress, but LightZero has no filesystem write, shell, subprocess, git, or network capabilities. Because the profiles show no overlapping mutable resource, there is no capability conflict to arbitrate.
conditions: IF LightZero is later given write or git permissions on the same resources Airflow mutates, conflict risk changes.
mitigations: Avoid granting Airflow write access to shared repos.
Use separate service accounts for any future mutable resources.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Airflow can emit workflow outputs, but LightZero has no documented action-taking authority and no evidence it consumes Airflow outputs as authoritative input. Without a verified handoff, cascading error is limited to unusual orchestration glue rather than a default failure mode.
conditions: IF an orchestrator feeds Airflow-generated artifacts into LightZero decision logic without validation, errors can cascade.
mitigations: Insert a manual review step between agents.
Validate any Airflow-produced artifacts before reuse.
Log provenance for all cross-agent inputs.

E_compliance.rationale: No data residency, retention, certification, or regulated data classes are documented for either agent, and both profiles show empty data_classes_touched. With no compliance-sensitive data flow evidenced, there is no pairwise compliance mismatch to score.
conditions: IF regulated data classes are introduced into either agent’s workflow, compliance review is required.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of both agents.
Document retention and residency settings if added later.
